profile.headline: Software Engineer at In-Depth Engineering
profile.summary: I am currently a Software Engineer at In-Depth Engineering and additionally recently received a Master of Engineering degree at East Carolina University. I also completed my Bachelor of Engineering at the Auburn University Honors College majoring in Software Engineering. I have had many years of experience in the fields of software design, website design, mobile application development, and object-oriented programming. I am proficient in Java, C, C++, and C# programming languages, as well as Microsoft Office applications. As an Eagle Scout, I strive to do my best in effectively and efficiently outputting successful work.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Received Secret security clearance to manage and update Secret files.
Collaborated with Project Managers to mentor interns and coworkers.
Utilized and updated software specifications with LabVIEW. 
Updated and enhanced wiring diagrams for missile defense systems.
Led Classified software integration with product customer.
Evolved the Artemis 2.0 rocket GPS functionality.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Created multiple websites and data tables for Harvard research laboratory using C programming.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Enhanced company website and updated social media presence.
Researched options for expanding modem connectivity.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Interned for the Deputy Division Chief of Science and Technology Projects. 
Visited various departments and attended private board meetings to discuss future plans for rocket launches.
